messages:
Sam: Heads up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7890 needs 2x LGTM before the 23:45 UTC cutoff. @matt is OOO today, can someone pick up second eyes? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Kira: I can try. Quick question — QA flagged an e2e flake on this branch, is that the blocker?
Sam: Yep, QA reported a flaky kv-cache-regen test in the nightly run. Logs pasted below. We want to avoid delaying the hotfix but also don’t want to merge a flakey fix.
Sam: ```
FAIL kv-cache-regen.spec.ts > shard-3 > should warm KV cache within 500ms
  Error: Timeout - waited 500ms
  at Object.fail (/app/tests/kv-cache-regen.spec.ts:42:12)
  --- logs show sporadic delay in warm path on p3 instances
```
Bob: I can take a look in ~20m. If it's infra/timing related we should consider raising the timeout slightly for this patch and schedule follow-up to root-cause.
Jen: QA here — we ran the e2e 3x: two passes, one fail. The failure correlates with heavy background batching. Increasing timeout hides the problem but is acceptable as a short-term mitigation if we add a test ticket.
Kira: Agree with Jen. If Bob can reproduce locally and gives +1, I'm comfortable with a temporary timeout bump plus a test/bug for investigation. We still need the 2nd LGTM though.
matt: Sorry I was OOO, back online now. I can do a quick skim in 10. If Bob repros and confirms it's nondeterministic, I can give the second LGTM and we do the short rollback plan after deploy.
Bob: Reproduced locally with a repro script. Patch looks safe — only touches cache warm path timing and adds a small buffer. I can give +1 pending CI green. :thumbsup:
Sam: Great — tagging CI. @deploy-bot can you post cutoff reminder?
deploy-bot: Reminder — hotfix cutoff for PRs targeting release/rc at 23:45 UTC (in 25m). Ensure 2x LGTM and passing CI or the PR will be pushed to next window.
Jen: CI green on unit + integration, e2e rerun queued. If e2e passes I'll mark QA +1.
Kira: I read the changes, OK from me on safety and rollback plan. Giving my LGTM now. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Bob +1 noted, Kira +1, waiting for matt and QA final.
matt: Skim done — looks fine and reversible. I'm giving LGTM. :eyes:
Jen: e2e passed on rerun, QA +1.
Sam: Awesome — we have 2x LGTM and QA signoff. Proceeding to merge shortly before cutoff. Thanks everyone for the quick handoff. :rocket:
Bob: After merge I'll monitor the canary and have rollback steps ready if latency spikes.
Sam: Plan: merge in 5, canary monitor 10m, full rollout if no regressions. If anyone sees issues ping #incidents immediately.
deploy-bot: Merge schedule: PR #7890 merged at 3509876660. Canary monitors active.
